name: Real estate & property
seoTitle: AI & Software Solutions for Real estate & property | Fruition
seoDescription: 16 real estate & property use cases on monday.com, 2 with AI. See the process, boards, automations and integrations for each.
heading: Real estate & property use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do real estate & property organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 16 real estate & property use cases. The most common are integrations & migration (11), operations & ERP (10), work & project management (9), most often for operations & delivery, sales & CRM, finance & procurement teams.

faq.question: How long does a real estate & property monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete real estate & property build is under 6 weeks. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do real estate & property builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in real estate & property use cases are Make, Buildium, Email and activity tracking, AppFolio, n8n, Base44 web form.

faq.question: Does Fruition build AI agents for real estate & property?
faq.answer: Yes. 2 of the real estate & property use cases on this page include an AI step. Examples: Delinquency cadence → SMS (Twilio) and AI voice calls (Vodex.ai); Inbound call → AI voice agent captures intent; owner enquiries prioritised to the principal, guest calls routed to the responsible property manager.

useCases.title: Short-term rental management company
useCases.summary: All guest calls funnelled through one number to the business owner, so high-value new-owner enquiries were missed during peak guest-call periods and no call records were captured against bookings.
useCases.challenge: All guest calls funnelled through one number to the business owner, so high-value new-owner enquiries were missed during peak guest-call periods and no call records were captured against bookings.
boards: Cloud phone system: users, teams, numbers, call recording, transcripts and sentiment summaries
AI voice agent front door identifying caller intent (new property owner vs guest)
Property-manager routing map using property name and manager name
automations: Inbound call → AI voice agent captures intent; owner enquiries prioritised to the principal, guest calls routed to the responsible property manager
Ambiguous property → AI clarification prompt before routing
Property manager no answer → overflow to VA → escalation to principal
Call ends → summary, key topics, action items and recording link pushed to the matching booking in the reservation system via make.com, with phone-number matching and dedupe
useCases.outcome: Answer every inbound call, separate owner enquiries from guest calls, route guests to the right property manager with a defined escalation chain so no call goes unanswered, and log call intelligence against the correct booking.
